title: PortalMod: Additions
description: An addon that adds decorative blocks and greater functionality to the portalmod mod.
body:
![PMODaddition](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c89b69f8d26fb1b13bc1744f8f9b3f946fd2176.png)

An add-on for PortalMod that adds new blocks, cores and new test elements.

The add-on adds more variations of cubes and fields, and introduces gel droppers


## FAQ

Q:How do I change the mode on the gel dropper?

A:Right-click it with a bucket of any gel (except those from other add-ons).
